windshield.strip: material along the top not extending below the AS-1 line or 5 in. from the top, whichever is closer to the top, is not regulated; below that the windshield must keep 70% (+/-3) light transmittance, film + glass, not red or yellow

frontSide.note: film + glass combined, plus or minus 3%; not red or yellow

backSide.note: any other window is allowed; outside left and right mirrors required if the rear window is below 50% (+/-3)

rear.note: outside left and right rear-view mirrors required if rear window light transmittance is below 50% (+/-3)

tint.measuredHow: film + glass combined ('when used in conjunction with the safety glazing materials')

tolerance.cite: Ohio Adm. Code 4501-41-03(A)(2)-(4) ('plus or minus three per cent')

tint.dualMirrors: Outside left and right rear-view mirrors required when the rear window is tinted below 50% (+/-3)
tint.certificateOrSticker: Since 1990 model year: a label with manufacturer name and % light transmission must be installed between film and glass, lower left-hand corner of each tinted window viewed from outside (4501-41-03(F))

medicalExemption.text: Affidavit signed by an Ohio-licensed physician (ch. 4731) or optometrist (ch. 4725) stating the person (or vehicle registered to the person's parent, guardian or spouse) needs darker sunscreening; the affidavit must be in the vehicle at all times while the person is in it. No state permit issued.

penalty.text: Operating a non-conforming vehicle or reflective material: minor misdemeanor (fine up to $150, ORC 2929.28). Installing non-conforming material: misdemeanor of the fourth degree.

tint.lastAmended: ORC 4513.241 effective April 9, 2025 (HB 403, 135th GA); OAC 4501-41-03 effective Nov 22, 2014, next review 1/1/2031
quotes: applied to the windshield when used in conjunction with the safety glazing materials of such window, has a light transmittance of not less than seventy per cent plus or minus three per cent and is not red or yellow in color

applied to the side windows to the immediate right or left of the driver, so long as such material ... has a light transmittance of not less than fifty per cent plus or minus three per cent and is not red or yellow in color

outside left and right rear view mirrors are required if the sunscreening material is applied to the rear window and the sunscreening material ... has a light transmittance of less than fifty per cent plus or minus three per cent
applied along the top of the windshield and that does not extend downward beyond the AS-1 line or five inches from the top of the windshield, whichever is closer to the top, is not regulated
No reflectorized materials shall be permitted upon or in any front windshield, side windows, sidewings, or rear window.
Whoever violates division (C), (E)(2), or (F) of this section is guilty of a minor misdemeanor.

helmet.conditions: Operators and passengers under 18; operators with a 'novice' endorsement (first year) and their passengers; temporary instruction permit holders

handheldPhone.noviceOrAgeBan: Stricter rules for probationary (under-18) drivers exist in ORC 4507.071 (not read)
handheldPhone.fineText: Up to $150 first offense (or distracted driving course instead), up to $250 second within 2 years, up to $500 third+ (possible 90-day suspension); doubled in posted construction zones

studdedTires.season: Nov 1 - Apr 15 (retractable studs may be carried retracted year-round; public safety vehicles and school buses exempt)

radarDetector.note: No state ban found; commercial vehicles over 10,001 lb banned federally (49 CFR 392.71)

liftHeight.rule: Maximum bumper height (or frame-rail height where bumpers are absent or modified) for passenger cars, multipurpose vehicles and trucks up to 10,000 lb GVWR set by Director of Public Safety rules; numeric limits in the rule not read

openQuestions: codes.ohio.gov refused connections; all texts read from Wayback snapshots (studded tires and helmet snapshots are 2021/2023 versions)
